about.uses_hindi: बुखार, तेज सिरदर्द, दांत दर्द और बदन दर्द को जल्दी कम करने में असरदार।
about.what_it_does: Crocin 650 is a fast-acting paracetamol formulation designed to reduce elevated body temperature (fever) and alleviate mild to moderate pain.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet after food with water. Maintain at least 4-6 hours between doses. Maximum 4 tablets in 24 hours.
about.safety_tip: Avoid consuming with other paracetamol-containing products or excessive alcohol.

about.uses_hindi: तेज बुखार, वायरल बुखार, सिरदर्द और मांसपेशियों के दर्द में सबसे ज्यादा इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली दवा।
about.what_it_does: Dolo 650 contains 650mg paracetamol with antipyretic and analgesic action, commonly recommended for viral fevers, flu, and body ache.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet with a glass of water after meals. Do not exceed the prescribed frequency.
about.safety_tip: Overdose can cause serious liver injury. Safe for most adults when used as instructed.

about.uses_hindi: जोड़ों का दर्द, मांसपेशियों में खिंचाव, दांत दर्द और सूजन के साथ होने वाले दर्द में तुरंत राहत।
about.what_it_does: Combiflam combines Ibuprofen (NSAID) and Paracetamol for dual pain relief and anti-inflammatory action on swollen joints or muscles.
about.how_to_take: Always take strictly after food or with milk to protect your stomach lining.
about.safety_tip: Not recommended for patients with active stomach ulcers or severe kidney disorders.

about.uses_hindi: कमर दर्द, गर्दन दर्द, मोच और जोड़ों के दर्द पर सीधे लगाने वाला असरदार पेन रिलीफ जेल।
about.what_it_does: Volini Gel contains Diclofenac and Methyl Salicylate which penetrate deep through the skin to relax tense muscles and reduce acute inflammation.
about.how_to_take: Gently apply a thin layer onto the affected area 3-4 times daily. Do not massage vigorously.
about.safety_tip: For external use only. Do not apply on open cuts, wounds, or sensitive mucous membranes.

about.uses_hindi: गठिया (Arthritis), स्पॉन्डिलाइटिस और पुराने जोड़ों के तेज दर्द व सूजन में राहत।
about.what_it_does: Naprosyn is a long-acting NSAID (Naproxen) providing 12-hour relief from joint stiffness and inflammatory swelling.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet twice daily with food or as prescribed by your orthopedist.
about.safety_tip: May cause acidity or GI discomfort; often prescribed with an antacid.

about.uses_hindi: एलर्जी, छींक आना, बहती नाक, आंखों में खुजली और त्वचा पर चकत्ते (Urticaria) में राहत।
about.what_it_does: Cetzine contains Cetirizine, a non-drowsy second-generation antihistamine that blocks allergic histamine receptors.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet once daily in the evening with water, with or without food.
about.safety_tip: May cause mild drowsiness in some individuals. Avoid driving after your first dose.

about.uses_hindi: सांस लेने में दिक्कत, मौसमी जुकाम, लगातार छींकें और दमा (Asthma) के एलर्जी लक्षणों में।
about.what_it_does: Montair-LC combines Levocetirizine and Montelukast to prevent airway narrowing and allergic airway inflammation.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet once daily at night before sleeping.
about.safety_tip: Best taken consistently at the same time each evening for peak respiratory protection.

about.uses_hindi: सूखी खांसी, गले की खराश और बार-बार उठने वाली खांसी को शांत करने वाला सिरप।
about.what_it_does: A triple-action dry cough syrup with Dextromethorphan (cough suppressant), Phenylephrine (decongestant), and Chlorpheniramine.
about.how_to_take: Take 5-10 ml using the measuring cup, 2 to 3 times a day as directed.
about.safety_tip: Avoid drinking cold water immediately after taking the syrup to allow the throat soothing coating to work.

about.uses_hindi: दमा (Asthma) या सांस फूलने पर तुरंत सांस की नली खोलने वाला इमरजेंसी इनहेलर।
about.what_it_does: Asthalin delivers Salbutamol directly into the bronchial tubes, opening airways within 2-5 minutes during sudden bronchospasm.
about.how_to_take: Inhale 1-2 puffs as required during wheezing or breathlessness, holding breath for 10 seconds after inhalation.
about.safety_tip: Rinse mouth with water after use. Always keep this reliever inhaler within easy reach.

products.name: Otrivin Oxy Fast Relief Nasal Spray

about.uses_hindi: बंद नाक को 25 सेकंड में खोलने और सर्दी-जुकाम में आसान सांस लेने के लिए।
about.what_it_does: Fast-acting nasal decongestant (Oxymetazoline) that constricts swollen blood vessels in nasal passages.
about.how_to_take: Spray 1 puff into each nostril 2-3 times daily.
about.safety_tip: Do not use for more than 5-7 consecutive days to avoid rebound nasal congestion (rhinitis medicamentosa).

about.uses_hindi: गले, कान, छाती (निमोनिया), त्वचा और यूरिनरी ट्रैक्ट के बैक्टीरियल इन्फेक्शन में।
about.what_it_does: Broad-spectrum antibiotic combining Amoxicillin with Clavulanic acid to overcome bacterial enzyme resistance.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet twice daily after a meal at fixed 12-hour intervals.
about.safety_tip: Complete the full course prescribed by your doctor even if you feel better after 2 days.

about.uses_hindi: गले का संक्रमण (Tonsillitis), ब्रोंकाइटिस और श्वसन तंत्र के बैक्टीरियल इन्फेक्शन में।
about.what_it_does: Azithromycin 500mg macrolide antibiotic with high tissue penetration, usually prescribed for 3 or 5 days.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet daily 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals.
about.safety_tip: Prescription antibiotic; do not discontinue course early without consulting your physician.

about.uses_hindi: यूरिन इन्फेक्शन (UTI), पेट के इन्फेक्शन और टाइफाइड बुखार के इलाज में उपयोगी।
about.what_it_does: Ciprofloxacin fluoroquinolone antibiotic that halts bacterial DNA synthesis.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet every 12 hours with plenty of fluids to protect kidney function.
about.safety_tip: Avoid taking antacids, calcium, or iron supplements within 2 hours of this medicine.

about.uses_hindi: कान, साइनस, गले और फेफड़ों के बैक्टीरियल इन्फेक्शन में ली जाने वाली एंटीबायोटिक।
about.what_it_does: Cefixime 200mg third-generation cephalosporin active against resistant gram-negative bacteria.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet twice daily after food.
about.safety_tip: Take strictly under medical guidance.

about.uses_hindi: एसिडिटी, सीने में जलन (Heartburn), खट्टी डकारें और उल्टी-मितली की शिकायत में।
about.what_it_does: Combines Pantoprazole (reduces acid secretion) with Domperidone (prevents reflux and nausea).
about.how_to_take: Take 1 capsule on an empty stomach in the morning, 30 minutes before breakfast.
about.safety_tip: Swallow whole; do not chew or crush the capsule pellets.

about.uses_hindi: पेट में गैस, एसिडिटी, पेट के अल्सर और भारीपन को शांत करने के लिए।
about.what_it_does: Pantoprazole 40mg proton pump inhibitor that provides 24-hour gastric acid suppression.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet once daily in the morning before food.
about.safety_tip: Safe for regular use when prescribed for GERD or acid reflux.

about.uses_hindi: तुरंत एसिडिटी और पेट की जलन को शांत करने वाला कूलिंग मिंट जेल।
about.what_it_does: Quickly neutralizes excess stomach acid within 60 seconds with magnesium and aluminum hydroxides.
about.how_to_take: Take 1-2 teaspoonfuls (5-10 ml) after meals or when feeling heartburn.
about.safety_tip: Shake bottle well before use.

about.uses_hindi: दस्त (Loose motions), पेट खराब, और एंटीबायोटिक लेने के बाद आंतों के गुड बैक्टीरिया को वापस लाने में।
about.what_it_does: Probiotic formulation with Lactic Acid Bacillus to restore healthy gut microflora balance.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet twice daily with water or buttermilk.
about.safety_tip: Can be taken safely alongside or after antibiotic treatments.

about.uses_hindi: हाई ब्लड प्रेशर (High BP) को कंट्रोल करने और दिल को सुरक्षित रखने वाली दवा।
about.what_it_does: Telmisartan 40mg angiotensin receptor blocker that relaxes blood vessels to lower blood pressure.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet daily at the exact same time every morning.
about.safety_tip: Do not stop taking abruptly even when blood pressure reads normal.

about.uses_hindi: हाई ब्लड प्रेशर और सीने के दर्द (एंजाइना) में रक्त प्रवाह को सुचारू करने के लिए।
about.what_it_does: Amlodipine 5mg calcium channel blocker that dilates coronary and peripheral arteries.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet once daily with water.
about.safety_tip: Inform doctor if you notice mild swelling in your feet or ankles.

about.uses_hindi: खून को पतला रखकर हार्ट अटैक और स्ट्रोक के खतरे से बचाने वाली जरूरी दवा।
about.what_it_does: Low-dose Aspirin 75mg that inhibits platelet clumping to prevent blood clots in coronary arteries.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet daily strictly after a full meal.
about.safety_tip: Consult doctor before dental procedures or surgery.

about.uses_hindi: बैड कोलेस्ट्रॉल (LDL) और ट्राइग्लिसराइड्स को कम करके नसों को ब्लॉक होने से बचाने के लिए।
about.what_it_does: Rosuvastatin 10mg statin that inhibits liver cholesterol production and improves arterial elasticity.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet once daily, preferably at bedtime.
about.safety_tip: Maintain a healthy low-fat diet and exercise routine for best lipid control.

about.uses_hindi: टाइप-2 डायबिटीज में ब्लड शुगर लेवल को नियंत्रित करने की पहली और सबसे भरोसेमंद दवा।
about.what_it_does: Metformin 500mg sustained release that improves insulin sensitivity and lowers liver glucose output.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet with or immediately after meals.
about.safety_tip: Sustained release formulation: swallow whole without chewing.

about.uses_hindi: शुगर लेवल जब सिंगल दवा से कंट्रोल न हो, तब इंसुलिन रिलीज बढ़ाने के लिए।
about.what_it_does: Combination of Glimepiride (stimulates insulin) and Metformin (lowers insulin resistance).
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet in the morning with your main breakfast.
about.safety_tip: Always carry a source of glucose/sugar in case of hypoglycemia.

about.uses_hindi: भोजन के बाद अचानक शुगर बढ़ने (Post-meal spike) को रोकने वाली एडवांस डायबिटीज दवा।
about.what_it_does: Sitagliptin 100mg DPP-4 inhibitor that increases incretin hormones only when blood sugar rises.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet once daily with or without food.
about.safety_tip: Lower risk of causing hypoglycemia or weight gain.

about.uses_hindi: घर पर एक बूंद खून से केवल 5 सेकंड में सटीक ब्लड शुगर चेक करने के लिए।
about.what_it_does: 50 capillary blood glucose test strips compatible with Accu-Chek Active glucometer.
about.how_to_take: Insert strip, apply tiny blood droplet to the designated green test pad.
about.safety_tip: Keep the vial tightly closed to protect strips from humidity.

about.uses_hindi: कमजोर हड्डियों, जोड़ों के दर्द और कैल्शियम व विटामिन D3 की कमी को पूरा करने के लिए।
about.what_it_does: Elemental Calcium 500mg plus Vitamin D3 250 IU for maximum bone mineral density.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet daily after lunch or dinner with water.
about.safety_tip: Maintain good daily hydration.

about.uses_hindi: मुंह के छालों (Mouth Ulcers), कमजोरी, बालों के झड़ने और रोग प्रतिरोधक क्षमता बढ़ाने में।
about.what_it_does: Therapeutic B-Complex vitamins (B1, B2, B6, B12, Niacinamide, Folic Acid) fortified with Zinc and Vitamin C.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 capsule daily after breakfast.
about.safety_tip: Safe for regular daily nutritional maintenance.

about.uses_hindi: विटामिन D की भारी कमी, हड्डियों की कमजोरी और बदन में लगातार सुस्ती-थकान के लिए।
about.what_it_does: High-potency Cholecalciferol (60,000 IU) softgel to quickly replenish vitamin D stores.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 capsule ONCE A WEEK with milk or food, for 4-8 weeks as prescribed.
about.safety_tip: Take strictly once weekly, NOT daily.

products.name: Zincovit Tablet
products.salt: Multivitamin + Multimineral with Grape Seed Extract

about.uses_hindi: इम्यूनिटी बढ़ाने, कमजोरी दूर करने और रिकवरी तेज करने वाला संपूर्ण मल्टीविटामिन।
about.what_it_does: Multivitamin, multimineral and grape seed extract tablet for energy, stamina, and cellular protection.
about.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet daily after food.
about.safety_tip: Ideal daily supplement for adults.

about.uses_hindi: त्वचा पर खुजली, एक्जिमा, लाल दाने और बैक्टीरियल इन्फेक्शन में आराम देने वाली क्रीम।
about.what_it_does: Betamethasone (anti-inflammatory steroid) and Neomycin (antibiotic) for infected dermatoses.
about.how_to_take: Apply a thin layer to the affected clean skin area 2 times daily.
about.safety_tip: Do not apply on face or use continuously for more than 7 days without doctor advice.

about.uses_hindi: फंगल इन्फेक्शन, दाद, खाज, खुजली और रिंगवर्म में तुरंत राहत देने वाली क्रीम।
about.what_it_does: Clotrimazole (antifungal) and Beclomethasone (soothing steroid) to eradicate fungal skin infections.
about.how_to_take: Gently massage into the affected skin twice a day after washing and drying the area.
about.safety_tip: Continue application for 2-3 days after symptoms clear to prevent fungal relapse.

about.uses_hindi: चेहरे के कील-मुंहासे (Acne & Pimples) और पस वाले दानों को सुखाने वाला असरदार जेल।
about.what_it_does: Clindamycin topical antibiotic that eradicates acne-causing bacteria and unclogs inflamed pores.
about.how_to_take: Wash face with mild cleanser, pat dry, and apply a small pea-sized amount onto pimples at night.
about.safety_tip: Avoid contact with eyes, lips, and corners of the nose.

products.name: Omron HEM-7120 Digital BP Monitor
products.salt: Fully Automatic Upper Arm Blood Pressure Monitor

about.uses_hindi: घर पर सटीक ब्लड प्रेशर और पल्स रेट नापने की क्लीनिकली वैलिडेटेड ऑटोमैटिक मशीन।
about.what_it_does: Oscillometric digital blood pressure monitor with Intellisense technology for comfortable, accurate readings.
about.how_to_take: Wrap cuff around upper arm at heart level, sit calmly for 5 minutes, and press START.
about.safety_tip: Do not smoke, drink caffeine, or exercise 30 minutes before measurement.

about.uses_hindi: चोट, खरोंच, घाव धोने, शेविंग के बाद और नहाने के पानी में कीटाणु खत्म करने के लिए।
about.what_it_does: Chloroxylenol-based medical antiseptic that kills 99.9% of bacteria on wounds and surfaces.
about.how_to_take: Dilute 1 tablespoon in a cup of water to cleanse minor cuts and grazes.
about.safety_tip: Never apply undiluted liquid directly onto open deep wounds.

about.uses_hindi: छोटी-मोटी चोट व खरोंच पर पानी और धूल-मिट्टी से बचाने वाली वॉटरप्रूफ पट्टी।
about.what_it_does: Breathable, skin-friendly washproof adhesive plasters with antiseptic wound pad.
about.how_to_take: Clean and dry wound, peel protective film, and apply pad directly over wound.
about.safety_tip: Change bandage at least once daily or if it becomes wet.
